commands.skyabyss.storm.overworld_only: The thunder wing can only be summoned in the overworld.
commands.skyabyss.storm.resting: The thunder wing is coming down to rest on a peak.

commands.skyabyss.storm.status_absent: Thunder wing not present (spawned before: %s). Storm window in %s s.

commands.skyabyss.stormmob.storm.cycle: Enemies back on the 90-second storm beat
commands.skyabyss.stormmob.storm.storm: Enemies held in the storm (feather wardens dive, moths charge fast)
gui.skyabyss.storm_heart.warn.cross: Thunder Cross - step between the lines
gui.skyabyss.storm_heart.warn.charge: Charged Floor - take to the air
item.skyabyss.gale_feather.desc: Crouch in midair to glide. Only inside the Windbone
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.storm_back: Found on the thunder wing's back. Tally strokes fill it to the edges
item.skyabyss.weathercock.desc: The cock points not at the wind, but at the storm
item.skyabyss.weathercock.desc2: Raise it somewhere high under open sky to call the storm
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_storm: On the floor at the center of the six rods in the beast's den. Only there is the stone unscorched.

Beneath the third catch-feather. On the wall beside it is a small carving of a person.

Its head was square.
On the antechamber wall below the keel gate. With an ear to the stone, the beat does seem to rise from somewhere beneath your feet.
On a stone beside the updraft, right under the skylight. Along its edge, strokes are cut in bundles of four.
Above the hearth in the tail chamber. Only the last line is cut shallow, as if in a hurry.
On the wall of the ledge by the goal. No one reaches it except on the storm's wind.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.raiju.body: When the beast fell, the lightning gathered in the knuckle had nowhere to go, and ran from rod to rod, again and again. At last the rods fell quiet.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.raiju.title: The Raiju
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_cower.body: While the sky shadow passed, the thunder wing clung to the peak with its head hidden under its wings. A bird the size of a mountain was afraid.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_cower.title: The Cowering Titan
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_ruins.body:
Two stone towers stood on the bird's back. Their walls are cut with short strokes, more than anyone could count.

No one was there. Wardens in copper helms walked the hollow bones. Behind the helms there was nothing.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_ruins.title: Ruins of the Wind Folk
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_stilled.bod:
The thunder wing's heart stopped. The wind deep in its chest fell still for the first time.

Above the storm, the sky had been clear all along. Even so, the bird never shed its storm.

Laid side by side in my palm, the three fragments drew together, tilting slightly downward.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_wing.body:
A distant storm was moving upwind. Each time the lightning flashed, the shape of wings showed inside the curtain of rain.

The wings were smaller than the sky shadow's.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_wing.title: The Storm Against the Wind
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.wind_ledger.body:
Calms and storms are tallied in strokes. From one day on, a small mark begins to appear beside them. It seems to mean: do not look up.

On the last page, there are no strokes at all.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.wind_ledger.title: The Wind Ledger
message.skyabyss.raiju.after: The lightning gathered in the knuckle lost its home, and ran from rod to rod again and again.
message.skyabyss.raiju.asleep: The den's master sleeps (it does not wake on Peaceful)
message.skyabyss.raiju.begin: The den's mouth seals. On a rod, the raiju rises
message.skyabyss.raiju.defeated: The raiju has fallen. The lightning in the knuckle has nowhere to go
message.skyabyss.raiju.east_stone_ready: At the crown of the knuckle, a wind chime stone waits to ring.
message.skyabyss.raiju.gathering: Entering the raiju's den. Gather within %s s
message.skyabyss.raiju.go: Raiju's nest: walk in to begin (5 s). /skyabyss raiju start to begin now
message.skyabyss.raiju.go_temporary: Raiju's nest (temporary, in the overworld sky until the storm back exists). Walk in to begin
message.skyabyss.raiju.hint_plug: Pull the plug at a rod's foot to ground it. A beast that lands on a grounded rod falls.
message.skyabyss.raiju.plug_wait: The plug has not come back yet (%s s)
message.skyabyss.raiju.roar: The raiju roars. Lightning is called to your feet!
message.skyabyss.raiju.stunned: The raiju fell onto a grounded rod. Now!
message.skyabyss.storm.against_wind: A distant storm was moving against the wind
message.skyabyss.storm.all_rung: The three The goal is reached together. On the hall floor, the ring of feathers comes undone...
message.skyabyss.storm.arrived: The wind carried you onto the bird's tail feathers. Far below your feet, the storm clouds flicker.
message.skyabyss.storm.calm_soon: A high cry, far off. A calm is coming
message.skyabyss.storm.campfire_hint: Crouch and touch the campfire to give up the trial and return to the tail chamber
message.skyabyss.storm.column_hint: Step into the updraft to be carried onto its back
message.skyabyss.storm.gale_feather: You take a gale feather. Crouch in midair to glide
message.skyabyss.storm.gale_feather_gone: Outside the trial, the feather melted into the wind
message.skyabyss.storm.gave_up: As you crouch by the campfire, the sound of the wind fades. You are back in the tail chamber
message.skyabyss.storm.keel_opened: The keel gate is open. Wind rushes up from below
message.skyabyss.storm.leaving: Through the feather gate, a wind smelling of rain blew you down to the ground
message.skyabyss.storm.mirrors_reset: The mirrors turned back to where they began
message.skyabyss.storm.mirrors_reset_wai: The reset mirror is still heavy (%s s)
message.skyabyss.storm.peaceful: The titan does not wake (the trials sleep while the game is on Peaceful)
message.skyabyss.storm.perching: The wind has turned. The storm is coming down onto the peak...
message.skyabyss.storm.return_hint: Stand in the outer face of the feather gate to return to the ground
message.skyabyss.storm.return_opened: Trial cleared. You will be returned to the hall shortly
message.skyabyss.storm.rod_full: The rod is full. A bone door slides open
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_east: Today the east stone is already singing (the Thunderbone sleeps)
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_front: Today the front stone is already singing (the Eye Hall sleeps)
message.skyabyss.storm.sleeping_west: Today the west stone is already singing (the Windbone sleeps)
message.skyabyss.storm.stone_silent: You cannot reach the goal yet. The den's master is still inside the knuckle
message.skyabyss.storm.storm_soon: The low moan of the wind grows. A storm is coming
message.skyabyss.storm.taking_off: The thunder wing spreads its wings. The hour of the squall is over
message.skyabyss.storm.trial_sleeping: This trial is asleep for now. Its stone is already singing
message.skyabyss.storm.trials_renewed: The thunder wing's heart beats again, a beat returning from deep beneath the ground. The trials on its back are as they were
message.skyabyss.storm.party_changed: Your party changed, and the trials with it. The wind carries you back to the wind hall
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.asleep: The heart is in a deep sleep (it does not wake on Peaceful)
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.begin: The entrance seals. In the middle of the keel chamber, the thunder wing's heart begins to beat
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.choice_late: Your first-victory gift (one of the unique legendaries) can be chosen with /titanmemory storm once the items exist
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.defeated: The thunder wing's heart has stopped. The wind in its chest falls still
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.descend: You go down below the keel gate. A beat like thunder rises from beneath
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.exit_hint: Stand in the pillar of light to return to the tail chamber
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.go: Gather in the keel antechamber (down the spiral below the keel gate)
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.pillar: The pillar of light carried you to the tail chamber
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.reward: What the thunder wing's heart left behind has passed into your hands
message.skyabyss.weathercock.called: Lightning struck the weathercock. The storm has noticed you
message.skyabyss.weathercock.next: %s until the hour of the squall
message.skyabyss.weathercock.no_sky: You can't see the sky. Go out from under the roof
message.skyabyss.weathercock.wait: The storm will not answer yet (%s min)
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_east: When a white ring appears at your feet, lightning is coming. If the ring is near a copper rod, the bolt strikes the rod instead. A full rod opens a bone door
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_front: The feather mirrors turn by hand. Guide the light from the eye to the three catch-feathers on the walls. If you get stuck, the reset mirror in the antechamber turns them back
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_heart: Beyond lies the keel chamber. The heart will test what you learned in the three trials, one at a time
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_hub: In calm, below; in storm, above. In a calm, take the ramp along the wall to the upper gallery. In a storm, the central updraft carries you up in one breath
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_landing: You stand on the tail feathers. Beyond the feather gate at the hips, something is beating
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_tail: The wind vane at the top right shows the beat of calm and storm. reach the goal (west, east, front) to open the keel gate in the hall floor. The steps in the west wall climb onto the back
message.skyabyss.whisper.storm_west: With the gale feather, crouch in midair to glide. In the rib hall, grates lift you: one step in calm, high in a storm, then glide to a ring. Shelter from crosswinds in a ledge corner
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.done: The hollow bones will be quiet for a while.
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.rounds: A note on the board, the ink run a little by rain: "Inside the bones on the bird's back, the copper-helmed wardens and the glowing moths are stirring again. Quiet eight of them."
Defeat feather wardens, moths and supplicants on the thunder wing
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.summar: Defeat eight feather wardens, static moths or thunder supplicants on the thunder wing's back. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.title: Rounds on the Thunder Wing
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.done: The storm has stopped. But the wind will gather again, surely.
A note in the corner of the board, in the same unsigned hand: "The storm comes back in seven days. Go and make sure, before it is back."
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.summar: Still the thunder wing's heart once more. Party members in the fight count too.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.title: The Storm's Heart, Once More
subtitles.skyabyss.storm_heart_beat: A heart beats behind the keel
subtitles.skyabyss.storm_heart_death: The heart stops; the wind falls still
subtitles.skyabyss.storm_heart_flash: The heart draws in the light
title.skyabyss.storm_back.sub: A bird's back, flying above the storm
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.west.gap: Jump the broken floors to the rib hall deep in the bone (%3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.west.stone: Touch the goal on the top ledge
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.west.done: The west stone rings. A glowing floor leads back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.west.sleep: This bone sleeps now. Its stone already rings
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.raiju: All three doors are open. Defeat the raiju in the far den
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.stone: The raiju has fallen. Ride the den's central updraft to the perch and touch the stone
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.done: The east stone rings. A glowing floor leads back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.sleep: This bone sleeps now. Its stone already rings
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.front.mirror: Guide the left eye's light to the three wall receivers with the feather mirrors. Right-click a mirror to turn it (receiver %3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.front.stone: The door is open. Touch the goal beyond it
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.front.done: The front stone rings. A glowing floor leads back to the hall
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.front.sleep: This hall sleeps now. Its stone already rings
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.hub.stones: Ring the three stones: west, east, front (%1$s / 3). Any order, any beat
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.hub.keel: All three stones ring. Go down through the keel gate in the hall floor
message.skyabyss.storm.gaps_done: You are at the end of the bone. Climb the rib hall
message.skyabyss.storm.door_shut: The bone door is shut. Complete the circuit before it (gold floor and levers)
message.skyabyss.storm.beak_shut: The door is shut. Light all three catch-feathers (%s / 3)
message.skyabyss.storm.keel_shut: The keel gate is shut. Ring all three the goal (%s / 3)
message.skyabyss.storm.beak_opened: The door is open. On to the stone
message.skyabyss.storm.beam_wall: The light hit a wall, not a catch-feather
message.skyabyss.storm.beam_back: The light stopped on a mirror's back. Turn it so the bright face meets the light
message.skyabyss.storm.beam_blocked: A static moth blocks the light. Defeat it
message.skyabyss.storm.beam_loop: The light circles in place. Turn a mirror
message.skyabyss.storm.beam_lit_already: That catch-feather already glows. Find another
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.west.rib: Climb the rib hall. Stand on a glowing vent and the wind lifts you to the ledge above (layer %3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.circuit: Flip the lever by your feet so the orange line reaches the door rod (door %3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.storm_gauge.locked: %s s left (turn the helm again to release)
message.skyabyss.storm.rib_top: The top ledge. On to the goal. Step off the east edge and the rings carry you down
message.skyabyss.storm.rib_ring: Passed a glide ring (%s / %s). The current carries you to the next ledge
message.skyabyss.storm.rib_down: The down rings carry you gently to the floor
message.skyabyss.storm.rib_enter: Stand on a grate and the wind lifts you. One step in calm, high in a storm. Ledge corners shelter from wind
message.skyabyss.storm.circuit_ok: The circuit is complete. The bolt reached the door rod
message.skyabyss.storm.circuit_decoy: The bolt fled to a dead-end rod. Flip the levers so the orange line reaches the door rod
message.skyabyss.storm.circuit_rewired: The bolt reached the door rod, but it did not fill. The circuit has rewired itself. Read the orange line again and strike once more
message.skyabyss.storm.circuit_ground: The bolt went to ground. Flip the grounding lever to connect the circuit
message.skyabyss.storm.lever_reaches: The orange line reaches the door rod. Stand on the gold floor to call the bolt
message.skyabyss.storm.lever_not_yet: The orange line does not reach the door rod yet (dead end or ground)
message.skyabyss.storm.pad_hint: Gold floor: keep standing and lightning strikes the circuit's intake rod (it will not hit you)
message.skyabyss.storm.lever_hint: Lever: switches the lightning's path. Success when the orange line reaches the door rod
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_calm: %s: wind locked to calm. %s s left
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_storm: %s: wind locked to storm. %s s left
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_end: The helm wind died down. The back's own wind returns
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_hint: Beat helms: calm (light blue) and storm (grey and yellow). Turn one to lock this trial's beat for 60 s. Either way the trial can be finished. Turn again to release
gui.skyabyss.storm_goal.east.pad: The orange line reaches the door rod. Stand on the gold floor to call the lightning (door %3$s / %4$s)
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_hint.west: Wind helm: light blue = calm (low updrafts, no crosswind), grey and yellow = storm (high updrafts, crosswind). Turn one to lock the wind for 60 s. Optional. Turn again to release
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_hint.east: Wind helm: light blue = calm (slow lightning), grey and yellow = storm (fast lightning and discharge lines). Turn one to lock it for 60 s. Optional. Turn again to release
message.skyabyss.storm.helm_hint.front: Wind helm: grey and yellow = storm brings one static moth that blocks the light (harder). Light blue = calm, no moth. 60 s lock. Optional. Turn again to release
message.skyabyss.storm.mirror_next: Hint: right-click the mirror shimmering with light to turn it
message.skyabyss.storm.circuit_demo: Demo: the lightning's path lit once. Make the orange line follow this same path with the levers
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_gate: Follow the feather road to the gate
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_hall: Pass the tail hall to the wind hall
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_west: Climb west into the wing bone
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_east: Climb east into the thunder bone
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_front_ven: Ride the middle updraft up to the gallery
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_front_tow: Climb the south-east tower to the gallery
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_front_nec: Follow the neck north to the Storm Crown

objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_west_gap: Cross the gap by beam or updraft
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_west_ston: reach the goal on the top ledge
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_east_leve: Pull the lever to reach the door rod
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_east_pad: Stand on the gold pad for lightning
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_east_raij: Defeat the raiju beyond the doors
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_east_ston: reach the goal on the perch
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_front_mir: Guide the light to three receivers
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_front_sto: reach the goal in the beak
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_heart: Go on to the heart room
message.skyabyss.storm.room.plaza: Feather Plaza: a rest stop. The lookouts to either side hold tablets and a gift.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.hub: Wind Hall: west is the wind bone, east the thunder bone, north the storm crown. The colored floor lines point the way.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.w0: Shoulder room: take the gale feather here. The helm lets you pick calm or storm.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.valley1: Wind Valley 1: cross the broken floor by walking the beam or riding the updraft.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.island: Island: a rest stop. The next valley's beam runs the other way.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.valley2: Wind Valley 2: the storm beat brings crosswind. Wait it out behind the shelter posts.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.elbow: Elbow cave: a rest stop. Beyond it the rib hall climbs upward.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.rib: Rib hall: stand in a glowing vent and the wind lifts you. Calm: step by step. Storm: glide through the rings.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.e0: Shoulder room: the thunder bone begins. The helm sets the lightning speed.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.circuit1: Circuit 1: pull the ground lever, then stand on the gold pad to call the bolt.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.circuit2: Circuit 2: the relay rod splits the path. Point the orange line at the door with the lever.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.circuit3: Circuit 3: two splits in a row. Check the orange line one fork at a time.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.circuit4: Circuit 4: the levers are not beside their rods. Watch where the orange line goes to tell which is which.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.east_ante: Antechamber: the raiju's nest lies ahead. Prepare at the rest fire.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.crown: Storm Crown hall: the front trial begins. A helm and a reset mirror are here.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.eye: Eye hall: guide the eye's light to the three receivers. Right-click a mirror to turn it.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.heart_ante: Keel antechamber: a rest stop. The heart waits beyond the gate.
message.skyabyss.storm_cache_vault_w: You took a small gift from the bone archive chest.
message.skyabyss.storm_cache_vault_e: You took a small gift from the storm forge chest.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.vault_w: Bone archive: a side room with tablets and a small gift.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.vault_e: Storm forge: a side room with tablets and a small gift.
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_bridge: Bridge: from the back plaza out over the tail. Four doors wait at the Landing to the south
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_yard: Trial Landing: a rest point. Only drawn doors open. Colored lines lead to them (light blue wind, gold thunder)
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s02: Air Sac Glide: stand in a lit sac for an updraft, then sneak to glide to the next sac
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s03: Pillar Crossing: orange tiles get struck, gold tiles are safe, and lightning runs pillar to pillar
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s10: Warden Watch: beating the guards wakes the wind vent. Rise on it and glide to the next post
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s09: Caller's Nest: rods catch nearby rings. A rod that caught three will discharge
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_hall: Leave the hall by its south exit
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_turr: Climb the tail hall spiral to the plaza
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_brid: Cross the south bridge of the plaza
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s02: Rise on a lit sac, glide on
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s03: Dodge the orange, cross the pillars
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s09: Advance to the middle of the nest
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s10_: Ride the vent to the next post
Defeat all the guards of this post
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d2_bridge: Second Bridge: south of the first Landing, out over the sky. Five more doors wait at the second Landing
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d2_yard: Second Landing: a rest point. Only drawn doors open. Colored lines lead to the doors
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s04: Feather Bridge: read the feathers before a gust and wait in the glowing lee
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s08: Pressure Valves: turn valves to set sac pressure to the gold marks. Green panel = +1, red = -1
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s07: Two Mirrors: flip mirrors to send the beam to the window. Same-colored pedestals are linked
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s12: Chief's Summit: pads leave half at a time. Yellow = leaving, orange = feather storm. The core is safe
message.skyabyss.storm.room.d_s11: Rod Escort: the cage moves while someone is near. Lightning strikes it. Guard from a distance
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s07_: Aim the beam at the catcher
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s08: Turn the valves to match the gold marks
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s11: Follow the cage from a safe distance
objective.skyabyss.trial_storm_deck_s12: Advance to the middle of the summit
